entries.normalized_statement: C, I, and A labels abbreviate dependent EqCert families for sibling permutations, typed quotient presentations, and visible same-head splicing at the exact semantic profile and port declaration.

Typed embeddings act recursively on free coordinates of ports and nodes, compose invocation embeddings, fix typed de Bruijn indices, recurse below binders, and choose no fresh free coordinate.

Support of an embedded port or node is exactly the image of its original support under the embedding.

For a fixed concrete invocation, there is a witness definitionally equal to that invocation; identity invocation equals the class abbreviation; and action by every later outer embedding equals invocation by the composite.
